title: A Counterexample to Small-time Limit Theorems for Stochastic Processes
summary: The standard small-time functional central limit theorem of semimartingales has been established in (Gerhold, S., Kleinert, M., Porkert, P., and Shkolnikov, M. (2015). Small time central limit theorems for semimartingales with applications. Stochastics, 87), proving that the scaling limit law of a large class of stochastic processes in increasingly small time scales is that of a Brownian motion with a possibly nontrivial variance-covariance matrix.
